description: Bookmarks' settings page, the Data and Diagnostics tabs in a sandbox, run by bookmarks-settings-probe.mjs. The Data tab lists the snapshots as the API does; Export downloads the server's envelope and says to keep it safe; the export imported back on the page (the file chosen, Merge, users by id): the dry run's report as text (nothing new), Import after the confirmation (nothing added, a snapshot first), the snapshot listed; Restore of that snapshot after its confirmation (the bookmarks as they were); Run the daily maintenance now queues it, and it runs; the users this server doesn't know shown exactly when Diagnostics lists any; the Diagnostics tab counts each user's bookmarks as the API does.

steps.name: the snapshots, as the API lists them
the list shown
steps.eval: (() => { const n = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)').querySelector('#BookmarksSnapshots'); return { summary: n.querySelector('.bookmarksSnapshotsSummary').textContent, names: Array.from(n.querySelectorAll('button.bookmarksRestore')).map(b => b.getAttribute('data-name')) }; })()

steps.name: the API's snapshots, newest first, a Restore button each
exported, with the file's name and the warning to keep it safe
steps.waitFor: /^Exported as bookmarks-export-\d{8}-\d{6}\.json\. It holds every user's bookmark names and notes: keep it safe\.$/.test(document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)').querySelector('#BookmarksExportStatus').textContent)

steps.name: the export, as the server gives it
what is in it
steps.eval: (e => ({ format: e.Format, plugin: e.Plugin, version: e.PluginVersion, schema: e.SchemaVersion, records: e.Data.Bookmarks.length, users: e.Users.length, settings: !!e.Settings }))(JSON.parse(__vars.exportText))

steps.name: the kit's envelope of Bookmarks 1.2.2.0, schema 2, with the settings
choose the export as the file to import (Merge, users by id)
steps.script: const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const input = p.querySelector('#BookmarksImportFile'); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([__vars.exportText], 'bookmarks-export.json', { type: 'application/json' })); input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); p.querySelector('#BookmarksImportMode').value = 'Merge'; p.querySelector('#BookmarksImportUsers').value = 'Id'; return input.files.length;

steps.name: Dry run is offered, Import isn't yet
what it says
steps.eval: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)').querySelector('#BookmarksImportReport'); return { summary: r.querySelector('.bookmarksImportSummary').textContent, users: Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('table.bookmarksImportUsers tr')).slice(1).map(tr => Array.from(tr.children).map(c => c.textContent)), html: r.querySelectorAll('b, i, a, img, script').length, applyDisabled: document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)').querySelector('#BookmarksImportApply').disabled }; })()

steps.name: the export of this server's own bookmarks: nothing new, each one unchanged (or skipped: a user deleted here), users found; Import offered
steps.assert: (m => !!m && Number(m[1]) + Number(m[2]) === __vars.export.records)(/The import would add 0, update 0, leave (\d+) unchanged, keep 0 newer here, remove 0, and skip (\d+) /.exec(__vars.dry.summary)) && __vars.dry.summary.indexOf('The file is an export of Bookmarks 1.2.2.0 (schema 2) from ') > 0 && __vars.dry.users.some(u => u[1] === 'Found') && __vars.dry.html === 0 && __vars.dry.applyDisabled === false

steps.name: the confirmation, open (its scale-up over: OK clicked while it runs is missed)
it says a snapshot comes first
steps.assert: __vars.confirmText.indexOf('A snapshot of the data as it is now is taken first.') >= 0

steps.name: the confirmation has settled: its OK in the same place over two frames, then a moment more (in 1 run of 22 in a Bookmarks 1.1.3 check, OK was clicked while the dialog was still opening, and the click was missed)
steps.waitFor: await (async () => { const box = () => { const b = document.querySelector('.dialogContainer button[data-id="ok"]'); if (!b) { return null; } const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 ? [r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height].join() : null; }; const first = box(); await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))); return !!first && first === box(); })()

steps.name: what the import did
steps.eval: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)').querySelector('#BookmarksImportReport'); return { summary: r.querySelector('.bookmarksImportSummary').textContent, snapshot: (/kept as (bookmarks-import-\d{8}-\d{6}\.json)/.exec(r.textContent) || [])[1] || null }; })()

steps.name: nothing added, a snapshot taken before
steps.assert: (m => !!m && Number(m[1]) + Number(m[2]) === __vars.export.records)(/Added 0, updated 0, left (\d+) unchanged, kept 0 newer here, removed 0, and skipped (\d+) /.exec(__vars.applied.summary)) && !!__vars.applied.snapshot

steps.name: the snapshot is listed (the list read again)
the import's confirmation is gone (jellyfin-web closes a dialog through the history, a moment after OK)
the confirmation, open (its scale-up over: OK clicked while it runs is missed)

the confirmation has settled: its OK in the same place over two frames, then a moment more (in 1 run of 22 in a Bookmarks 1.1.3 check, OK was clicked while the dialog was still opening, and the click was missed)
steps.waitFor: await (async () => { const box = () => { const b = document.querySelector('.dialogContainer button[data-id="ok"]'); if (!b) { return null; } const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0 ? [r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height].join() : null; }; const first = box(); await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))); return !!first && first === box(); })()

steps.name: the same bookmarks (the snapshot was the data just before the import), and a snapshot of their own taken first
steps.assert: JSON.stringify(__vars.countsAfter) === JSON.stringify(__vars.countsBefore) && /The data from just before was kept as bookmarks-restore-\d{8}-\d{6}\.json\.$/.test(__vars.restoreLine)

steps.name: the users this server doesn't know: shown exactly when Diagnostics lists any
the counts, as the server has them now
a row per user with the server's numbers, names only (no bookmark's text)
steps.assert: JSON.stringify(__vars.rows.map(r => [r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], r[4], r[7]])) === JSON.stringify(__vars.counts.Users.map(u => [(u.UserName || u.UserId) + (u.Known === false ? ' (not on this server)' : ''), String(u.Bookmarks), String(u.Named), String(u.Ranges), String(u.Detached), String(u.Clips)]))

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag, and jellyfin-web's Home tab pausing its slider while JE's Custom Tabs sync runs, excepted)
